summary:
Implemented the two stubs; no test files touched.

src/server/patch.ts: patchItem now runs the documented check order — 404 not_found for unknown id; 428 precondition_required when If-Match is missing; 422 invalid_patch via a validator (object, ≥1 key, only title/done, title non-empty ≤40 chars after trim, done boolean) reported before the version check; 412 version_conflict (with error.current = stored item) when If-Match (wildcard "*" or comma-separated ETags, whitespace-tolerant) doesn't match etagOf(stored); 200 with unchanged item (no version bump) when the trimmed patch equals stored values; otherwise stores trimmed fields, bumps version by 1, returns the new item with its ETag.

src/client/store.ts: applyOptimistic trims title, keeps version, records PendingOp{opId,id,patch,prev}, clears banner, returns state itself for unknown id. resolveOp replaces the item with the server copy and drops the op (identity return for unknown opId). rejectOp drops the op; on version_conflict with current it adopts error.current and sets the "Conflict: ..." banner, otherwise rolls back to op.prev with error.message as banner. ItemStore.edit: no-op for unknown id; if the item has a pending op it sets the '"<title>" is still saving.' banner without sending; otherwise takes an opId, applies optimistically synchronously, sends api.patchItem with the pre-change version, then resolves or rejects (transport throw → {code:"network", message:"Network error"}).

Verification: `bun test` from repo
